about_the_game:
In MultiEnding Heroes, you’ll join The Priest and The Hero on a wild adventure, where your decisions shape the fate of our brave (and occasionally clueless) heroes. Will they rise to greatness or stumble into disaster? With over 50 unique endings to discover, it’s up to you to guide them through every possible fate!

Key features

Unlock All Endings: The ultimate goal is to experience more than 50 endings! Each choice branches the story in new directions. Some endings lead to triumph, while others may leave our heroes in hilariously unfortunate situations.

Progress That Carries Over: Items and magics carry over to the next run, giving you more options in the future. The more you play, the more paths and endings you can uncover!

Choices matter:

Every action matters. Whether you’re casting magic, using items in critical moments, or even chatting with enemies mid-battle, your decisions will shape the heroes’ fate and the world around them.
